products_start_mode_shape.name: products_start_mode_shape
products_start_mode_shape.value: ("products"."start_mode" = 'FIXED' AND "products"."fixed_start_times" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."duration_options" IS NULL) OR ("products"."start_mode" = 'FREE' AND "products"."slot_interval_min" IN (10, 15, 20, 30, 60))

holidays_partial_needs_times.name: holidays_partial_needs_times
holidays_partial_needs_times.value: "holidays"."is_full_day" OR ("holidays"."start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "holidays"."end_time" IS NOT NULL AND "holidays"."start_time" < "holidays"."end_time")

work_exceptions_times_by_kind.name: work_exceptions_times_by_kind
work_exceptions_times_by_kind.value: ("work_exceptions"."kind" = 'OFF') OR ("work_exceptions"."start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "work_exceptions"."end_time" IS NOT NULL AND "work_exceptions"."start_time" < "work_exceptions"."end_time")
